mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_asset_extraction (extraction_id, asset_id, document_id, caption, ocr_text, summary, visual_kind, model_name, model_version, prompt_version, parser_version, attempt_count, confidence, raw_result, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (CAST(#{extractionId} AS uuid), CAST(#{assetId} AS uuid), CAST(#{documentId} AS uuid), #{caption}, #{ocrText}, #{summary}, #{visualKind}, #{modelName}, #{modelVersion}, #{promptVersion}, #{parserVersion}, #{attemptCount}, #{confidence}, COALESCE(CAST(#{rawResult} AS jsonb), NULL), #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE document_asset_extraction SET caption = #{caption}, ocr_text = #{ocrText}, summary = #{summary}, visual_kind = #{visualKind}, confidence = #{confidence}, raw_result = COALESCE(to_jsonb(#{rawResult}::text), NULL), status = 'ACTIVE', updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE extraction_id = CAST(#{extractionId} AS uuid)
UPDATE document_asset_extraction SET status = 'FAILED', raw_result = COALESCE(to_jsonb(#{rawResult}::text), raw_result), updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE extraction_id = CAST(#{extractionId} AS uuid)
UPDATE document_asset_extraction SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE asset_id = CAST(#{assetId} AS uuid) AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(attempt_count), 0) FROM document_asset_extraction WHERE asset_id = CAST(#{assetId} AS uuid)
mapper.update: UPDATE document_asset_extraction SET status = 'FAILED', updated_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND updated_at < #{now} - (#{timeoutMinutes} * INTERVAL '1 minute')
mapper.select: SELECT a.asset_id AS assetId, a.document_id AS documentId, d.kb_id AS kbId, a.content_hash AS contentHash, a.page_number AS pageNumber, a.locator::text AS locator, d.filename AS filename, d.filetype AS filetype FROM document_asset a JOIN document d ON d.id = a.document_id WHERE a.asset_type = 'IMAGE' AND a.status = 'READY' AND a.locator ?? 'derivedImage' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM document_asset_extraction e WHERE e.asset_id = a.asset_id AND e.status IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE') ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM document_asset_extraction f WHERE f.asset_id = a.asset_id AND f.attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts} ) ORDER BY a.created_at, a.asset_id LIMIT #{limit}
